experiment: Task A: verified immutable ELF images and pre-executed single-use workers

method.baseline: git archive of baseline_commit; native/host/admission sources unchanged; archive Git inventory and revision labels adapted only in benchmark metadata

limitations: Warm page cache, last-key two-column point fixture, one machine; no durability or throughput claim.
Fixed clock and cooperative heavy lock do not isolate all PC activity. Report session variation; no samples discarded.
Refill consumes CPU and per-image memory/descriptors; latency hiding is not work elimination. No runtime readiness handshake: remaining initialization may overlap selection.
All responses were checked by the harness; successful fixture builds use both official checkers; emitted C and pinned toolchain unchanged.
